Strategy: Give the single loosest bin a flat bonus of forty on top of Best Fit, so it sometimes wins over tighter bins without always dominating. It may help by spending loose capacity more often, but may fail by wasting the loosest bins on items that fit tightly elsewhere.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (40 if r == max(bins) else 0) for r in bins]
```
